#### What this PR does / why we need it:

[sig-node] PriorityPidEvictionOrdering [Slow] [Serial] [Disruptive] [NodeFeature:Eviction] should cause PIDPressure should eventually evict all of the correct pods
This test has been failing for long time.
According to the logs, fork-bomb-container-with-high-priority-pod is killed by OOM.
This PR reduces the number of processes to reduce overall memory usage.

https://prow.k8s.io/view/gs/kubernetes-ci-logs/logs/ci-crio-cgroupv2-node-e2e-eviction/1882132155849510912

Looking at some successful and failed runs, it seems the cause of the failure is race condition of eviction and OOM.
Apparently there is a threshold at around 10,000+, and if the number of process is over 10,000 and the eviction is delayed for some reasons, it is oom-killed instead of being evicted.

Also `sh` is using memory compared to `sleep`, so I removed `while` loop in the pid consuming pod.
